Prompt

Create a trustworthy, professional homepage for a property management company called "Keystone Property Group" that manages residential rental properties on behalf of landlords and investors. The page must serve two audiences simultaneously: property owners looking for management services and tenants looking for rentals or portal access. The design should feel established, reliable, and tech-forward without being cold.

1. NAVIGATION BAR
- Logo: "Keystone" with a keystone arch icon in #1D4ED8 (blue-700)
- Links: Services, Properties, About, Resources, Contact
- Two audience CTAs on right:
  - "Tenant Portal" (outline button, house-key icon)
  - "Free Rental Analysis" (solid #1D4ED8 blue, chart icon)
- White background, subtle bottom shadow, sticky on scroll
- Mobile: hamburger menu, "Tenant Portal" icon button visible

2. HERO SECTION (split audience)
- Full-width section with a high-quality background image of a well-maintained residential neighborhood at golden hour
- Dark gradient overlay (bottom-heavy)
- Content centered:
  - Eyebrow: "Managing 1,200+ Properties Across Greater Austin"
  - Headline: "Your Property, Our Priority."
  - Subheadline: "Full-service property management for single-family homes, multi-family units, and investment portfolios. Maximize your rental income while we handle everything."
  - Two CTA buttons: "Get a Free Rental Analysis" (solid blue, large) + "Browse Available Rentals" (outline white)
- Below hero: scrolling trust bar — "Licensed & Insured · BBB A+ Rated · NARPM Member · 4.8★ Google Reviews (340+)"

3. AUDIENCE SPLIT SECTION (two-column cards)
- Section headline: "How Can We Help You?"
- Two large cards side by side:
  - Card 1 — "Property Owners & Investors":
    - Icon: building with chart
    - "Tired of midnight maintenance calls? We handle tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance, inspections, and everything in between — so you can enjoy passive income."
    - 3 quick stats: "98% Occupancy Rate" · "21-Day Avg. Fill Time" · "15% Avg. ROI Increase"
    - CTA: "Explore Management Services →"
    - Border-top: #1D4ED8 blue

  - Card 2 — "Tenants & Renters":
    - Icon: house with key
    - "Looking for your next home? Browse our available rentals, apply online, and access your tenant portal for payments, maintenance requests, and lease documents."
    - 3 quick stats: "120+ Available Rentals" · "24/7 Maintenance Line" · "Online Rent Payment"
    - CTA: "Browse Available Rentals →"
    - Border-top: #10B981 emerald

- Each card: white background, 16px border-radius, colored top border, shadow on hover
- Background: #F0F9FF (light blue tint)

4. SERVICES OVERVIEW (icon grid + expandable)
- Section headline: "Full-Service Property Management"
- Subheadline: "Everything you need to protect and grow your investment."
- 6 service cards in 3x2 grid:

  - 💰 "Rent Collection" — "Automated online payments, late fee enforcement, and direct deposits to your account by the 10th of every month. 98.5% on-time payment rate."
  - 🔧 "Maintenance & Repairs" — "24/7 emergency line, vetted vendor network, and transparent pricing. All repairs approved by you before work begins (unless emergency)."
  - 📋 "Property Inspections" — "Move-in, move-out, and semi-annual inspections with detailed photo reports. Catch problems before they become expensive."
  - 📊 "Financial Reporting" — "Monthly owner statements, year-end tax packages (1099s), and a real-time owner portal with income/expense tracking."
  - ⚖️ "Legal & Compliance" — "Lease drafting, eviction management, fair housing compliance, and local ordinance monitoring. We keep you protected."
- Each card: icon, title, 2-sentence description
- Expandable "Learn More" link on each card opens detail panel with pricing note

- Section headline: "Why Owners Choose Keystone"

  - "Transparent Pricing" — "One flat percentage, no hidden fees. Leasing fee, management fee — that's it. We publish our pricing because we're not afraid of it." — Eye icon
  - "Tech-Forward" — "Real-time owner portal, online tenant payments, digital maintenance tracking, and automated financial reports. No more chasing paper." — Laptop icon
- Each block: icon, title, description
- Background: #F0F9FF

9. MANAGEMENT PRICING (transparent tiers)

- Below pricing: "No setup fees · No cancellation penalties · Pricing based on collected rent, not listed rent"

10. FAQ SECTION (accordion)
- "What types of properties do you manage?" — We manage single-family homes, duplexes, triplexes, condos, townhomes, and multi-family complexes (up to 50 units) across Greater Austin, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, and Georgetown.
- "How do you screen tenants?" — Every applicant goes through credit check, criminal background, eviction history, income verification (must earn 3x rent), employment verification, and landlord reference checks. Our average tenant stays 2.3 years.
- "How quickly can you fill a vacancy?" — Our average fill time is 21 days. We use professional photography, list on 40+ rental sites (Zillow, Apartments.com, etc.), and conduct showings 7 days a week.
- "When do I get paid?" — Owner disbursements are processed by the 10th of each month via direct deposit. You can track all income and expenses in real-time through your owner portal.
- "What if a tenant damages my property?" — Security deposits are held in a trust account and applied to damages beyond normal wear and tear. For larger issues, our rent guarantee program and landlord insurance recommendations provide additional protection.
- "Can I still be involved in decisions?" — Absolutely. You set your thresholds — for example, approve all repairs over $300. We handle the day-to-day and escalate based on your preferences.

- Background: #1E3A5F (dark blue) with subtle grid pattern overlay

Design: Professional, trustworthy, tech-forward. Primary: #1D4ED8 (blue-700 for CTAs and owner-focused elements), secondary: #10B981 (emerald for tenant-focused elements and positive indicators), accent: #F59E0B (amber for badges and highlights). Dark sections: #1E3A5F (navy). Backgrounds: white primary, #F0F9FF (blue tint) and #F8FAFC for alternating sections. Typography: DM Sans for headings (clean, professional, trustworthy), Inter for body. Cards with 16px border-radius and subtle shadows. Dual-audience design uses color coding (blue = owners, green = tenants) to guide navigation. Clean data presentation, transparent pricing, and trust-forward layout.

Responsive: Mobile-first. Hero CTAs stack vertically. Audience split cards stack. Service grid becomes 2-column then single column. Property carousel horizontal scroll with snap. ROI calculator full-width with stacked inputs. Pricing cards stack (Portfolio first). Testimonials stack. FAQ full-width. Final CTA form stacks vertically. Sticky mobile bottom bar alternates between "Free Analysis" (for owners) and "Browse Rentals" (for tenants) based on scroll position. All touch targets minimum 44px.
